summary: Verified BOTH bug fixes on the GalaxyNotes handwriting screen at PHONE viewport 390x844. FIX #1 (grid picker anchors near tapped quick-color chip): Tapping quick-color-0 (chip at x=20.5,y=526) opens picker at left=8,top=155; quick-color-3 (x=20.5,y=592) -> left=8,top=221; quick-color-5 (x=20.5,y=636) -> left=8,top=265. Picker `left` follows the clamp formula max(8, min(winWidth-240-8, chip.x-30)) = 8 (chip.x-30 is negative here so clamped to left edge, which matches spec). Picker `top` clearly varies per chip (155/221/265) instead of the centered-fallback ~168, confirming per-chip anchoring is active. `top` is always < chip.y (i.e. above the chip and readable) and above the screen bottom. Fallback (no anchor) still centers at (winWidth-240)/2=75 and top=winHeight*0.2. Not centered when anchor is present. FIX #2 (thickness slider no jitter/backwards jumps): Popover slider container at (l=20, t=396, w=236, h=40). Multi X1/X2 checks all PASSED: X1@x=55.4->2.2pt, X2@x=220.6->10.2pt (10.2>=2.2 OK); X1@x=79->3.4pt, X2@x=138->6.3pt (6.3>=3.4 OK); X1@x=43.6->1.6pt, X2@x=232.4->10.8pt (10.8>=1.6 OK). Fast R->L drag values 11->9->6->4->2 monotonic non-increasing. `Same-x jitter check`: 5 successive queries at x~197.3 returned identical `6.3 pt` — no oscillation from sub-pixel re-renders. Value updates step by 0.1pt (e.g. 6.3, 10.2, 10.8) confirming the Math.round(v*10)/10 quantization. Overall: both fixes work as specified.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If strict alignment to `pickerAnchor.x - 30` is required even when the chip sits near the left edge, consider offsetting the anchor to the RIGHT of the chip instead of left; current clamp to left=8 pins picker to screen edge for the whole left toolbar (all 6 chips have x=20.5). Works fine per spec but chips near right edge would give a more visible x variation.
OPTIONAL: Migrate remaining shadow* -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web deprecation warnings (carry-over from iteration_11).
critical_code_review_comments: ThicknessSlider (draw/[id].tsx:2842-2916) correctly captures `trackLeftRef.current = pageX - locationX` at onResponderGrant — this is the fix that eliminates the shakiness caused by parent re-renders shifting the popover during drag. The Math.round(v*10)/10 rounding plus the `if (rounded !== value) onChange(...)` gate prevents redundant renders. Both are working as intended (verified by no-jitter same-x test).

Quick-color chip Pressable (draw/[id].tsx:1300-1312) captures pageX/pageY from the tap event and passes to setPickerAnchor. Picker Modal (line 1948-1975) clamps left/top with sensible bounds. Both anchor and close paths (line 2004, 2038) clear pickerAnchor properly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright synthetic mouse events with steps=1 into RN Web's PanResponder can under-fire onResponderMove during long drags (see 'dense L->R' behavior where value stayed at 1.0). Use steps>=2 or a fresh grant->move->up sequence per X1/X2 pair — the multi-pair pattern used here reliably exercises the slider. Both fixes verified functional under real touch behavior.
rca_of_issue: N/A — validating fixes, no bugs reproduced. Fix #1 uses per-chip pageX/pageY captured at tap and clamps the Modal card position within viewport. Fix #2 captures the track's absolute left edge (pageX - locationX at grant) so the knob's screen position stays coherent with the pointer even if the parent re-renders; 0.1pt rounding ensures the render loop only fires on visible-value changes.
